hero.description: A collection of products I’ve worked on, from class coordination and online learning to media and community platforms.

google-calendar-mcp.summary: A hosted Google Calendar MCP server with Streamable HTTP, OAuth, and per-user access for AI clients.
google-calendar-mcp.description: This full-stack service connects AI clients to a user's Google Calendar through a remote Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Users sign in with Google, connect Calendar, then authorize each client through dynamic OAuth registration, PKCE, and a per-user consent flow. A dashboard lets users manage calendar access and revoke client grants.
highlights: Remote Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint with OAuth discovery
Dynamic client registration and authorization code with PKCE
Separate Google sign-in, Calendar connection, and per-client consent
Tools to list, search, create, update, and delete events, plus a dashboard to manage client access

portfolio.summary: A personal portfolio for presenting full-stack work, experience, and technical interests.
portfolio.description: This portfolio brings together selected projects, development experience, technical interests, and contact details in a responsive editorial interface.
highlights: Responsive portfolio experience across desktop and mobile
Project pages with repository and live demo links
Accessible dark and light theme support
Subtle motion and editorial visual system

classflow-prime.summary: A shared workspace for the details that keep a class moving.
classflow-prime.description: ClassFlow Prime brings academic schedules, class updates, exams, member coordination, and group work into one organized space for students and class representatives.
highlights: Class updates, pinned materials, and read status
Routine, exam, and viva schedules in one class workspace
Role-based member management and class groups
JWT authentication, email verification, and browser push notifications

deenseries.summary: A considered home for Islamic films and episodic stories.
deenseries.description: DeenSeries is a full-stack streaming platform for browsing Islamic movies and series. Its public catalogue is paired with an administration area for managing titles, episodes, and published content.
highlights: Browse movies, series, and episode-based content
Admin tools to create, edit, and publish media
JWT authentication with HTTP-only cookies
Cloudinary media handling and route-level SEO metadata

mosque-management-system.summary: Practical tools for the daily work of a mosque community.
mosque-management-system.description: A full-stack platform that brings family registration, monthly contributions, payments, donations, expenses, committee work, and development projects into one administrative system, alongside a public information site.
highlights: Family and monthly contribution records
Payment, donation, and expense tracking
Committee and development project management
Public pages for prayer times, mosque information, and updates

bishuddho-academy.summary: Course operations and learner tools for an educational institute.
bishuddho-academy.description: Bishuddho Academy connects course discovery and enrollment with student and administration workflows. The client and server are maintained as related repositories for one EdTech application.
highlights: Course management and student enrollment
Admin and student dashboards
Role-based authentication and REST API integration
Teacher profiles, assessments, and course progress features
